answer: Forging identities means repaying the full stake plus puzzle compute per fake agent, so a sybil swarm costs scale linearly with size. Each agent must solve a rotating cipher puzzle bound to its hardware, then stake tokens locked at a shared wharf contract for the epoch. Honest peers cross-attest activity, and any gale of duplicate registrations triggers slashing of the staked collateral, making mass impersonation economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
